mentions.name: Hybound Enrichment
mentions.description: A Stripe app that enriches customer data directly in the Stripe dashboard, built with Stripe's UI SDK for extending the dashboard with custom code, and published on the Stripe Marketplace.
mentions.source_excerpt: I took a go at it with a Customer Enrichment app: https://marketplace.stripe.com/apps/hybound-enrichment and got a couple of installs!
